baseline_models.focus_anchor: The predicate `كَذَّبَتْ`, temporal `قَبْلَهُمْ`, and coordinated subjects `قَوْمُ`, `أَصْحَابُ`, and `ثَمُودُ`.
baseline_models.mechanism: Form-II attribution of falsehood governs a serial set of earlier social bodies. `قَوْمُ` and `أَصْحَابُ` make the agency collective, while the dug or fixed image in `الرَّسِّ` materializes one collective through attachment to a site.

activation_trace.role: Attributing a thing or its bearer to falsehood supplies the governing act of collective rejection.
Temporal precedence places the coordinated subjects earlier than the current plural referent.
A people or social following supplies the first collective subject.
Companionship and durable association make the second subject a group defined by attachment.
Digging or insertion into a well or grave gives al-Rass a material site-image without replacing its proper-name function.

changed_reading.after: The ayah compresses a temporal precedent of whole social bodies assigning falsehood, including a body identified by lasting association with a dug or fixed place.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The conjunction of `قَوْمُ`, `أَصْحَابُ`, and `الرَّسِّ` under the singular feminine predicate `كَذَّبَتْ`.
baseline_models.mechanism: The people-root can image maintenance and the support by which something stands; companionship supplies repeated affiliation; al-Rass supplies fixation. Together they permit denial to be read as an institutionally maintained group posture rather than an accidental sum of private opinions.

activation_trace.role: The falsehood charge is the posture sustained by the social formation.
Standing over, preserving, and administering a thing supplies the mechanism of communal maintenance.
A support or order by which life stands makes the people an organized system, not merely a crowd.
Companionship supplies durable affiliation through which a posture can become shared.
Fixity and adhesion in one place sharpen the image of a socially embedded stance.

changed_reading.before: Members of several communities happen to reject a claim.
changed_reading.after: Each named community can be heard as a structure that stands by, associates around, and fixes a shared denial into social continuity.

baseline_models.mechanism: `قَبْل` carries both temporal priority and facing or capacity to meet something; `قَوْم` can carry collective resistance; `كذب` has a distant campaign-image of failing to carry a charge through. The prior peoples can therefore stand not only behind the addressees in time but in front of them as already failed confrontations.

activation_trace.role: Facing one thing with another turns temporal priority into a frontal precedent.
Capacity to face and repel supplies the issue tested by the earlier groups.
Collective resistance or matching an opponent gives the people an active confrontational stance.
A charge that does not hold true supplies an exploratory image of resistance that starts but cannot be completed.

changed_reading.after: The earlier collectives form a front of failed resistance already facing the present addressees along the path they are choosing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The catalogue continues through 50:14, where `كُلٌّ` closes over its members, `ٱلرُّسُلَ` supplies the omitted object of their denial, and the warning becomes due. The focus ayah is thus one segment of a message-response-consequence chain.

activation_trace.role: Attribution of falsehood is the focus act whose object and consequence are supplied by the catalogue's closure.
Messenger and message identify what the named collectives treated as false.
A fixed obligation becoming due turns denial into an act with an incurred consequence.
Threatening warning names the consequence whose realization closes the sequence.

structural_cues: 50:12-14 is one coordinated catalogue, and 50:14 closes it with `كُلٌّ`.
The object absent after `كَذَّبَتْ` in 50:12 appears as `ٱلرُّسُلَ` immediately before consequence language.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the continuous coordination, universal closure, messengers, and due warning; I let the closure scope backward over every listed name. A live narrower alternative is that the explicit object belongs locally to 50:14 while only framing the earlier clauses by parallelism.

changed_reading.before: The groups perform an unspecified denial.
changed_reading.after: Each listed social body becomes a precedent of rejecting message-bearers and thereby instantiating a warning that moves from speech to fixed consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus inventory clusters social support, companionship, and fixity, but 50:5 places denial of reality beside an affair that is mixed and disordered. The context reverses the baseline: the very denial a group stabilizes is what can destabilize its orientation.

activation_trace.role: A communal support and ordering structure supplies the apparently stable social system.
Companionship supplies the affiliations that hold the group's posture together.
Fixity and adhesion intensify the contrast between social rootedness and epistemic disorder.
Mixture and disturbance supply the disordered state coupled to denial of the real.

structural_cues: 50:5 sequences denial of `ٱلْحَقِّ` and the resulting or concomitant `أَمْرٍ مَّرِيجٍ`.
50:12 names denial through lexemes whose focus branches repeatedly image social standing, association, and fixation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the denial-disorder sequence and the focus stability cluster; I infer that maintained denial unmoors the community from stable judgment. The live reverse arrow is that prior confusion enables denial rather than being produced by it.

changed_reading.before: The groups are stable formations that maintain a shared denial.
changed_reading.after: Their cohesion is only organizational: fixing denial as a group posture leaves the collective's affair internally mixed and unable to hold a true orientation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus ayah, delivered water produces growth, dead land is given life, and that process is named as emergence. The well or burial branch of `الرَّسِّ` lets its otherwise opaque name become the subsurface hinge by which ecological revival turns into the history of dead communities.

activation_trace.role: A dug well, pit, or burial supplies the focus ayah's subsurface material anchor.
Durable association binds a human collective to that material site-image.
Water conveyed by pouring or irrigation begins the context's regenerative mechanism.
Vegetation emerging from earth makes visible what delivered water releases from below.
Earth's life through rain and vegetation converts the material sequence into revival.
Passing outward from containment names the emergence that transfers the ecological model to human return.

structural_cues: 50:9-11 forms water, growth, dead-land revival, and `كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْخُرُوجُ` immediately before 50:12.
The first historical label after that sequence containing an explicit focus branch for a well, pit, or burial is `الرَّسِّ`.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, the water-to-emergence sequence, and the Rass well or burial branch; I use al-Rass as a material transition rather than claiming a historical event. The live alternative is that al-Rass remains semantically opaque here and the revival analogy ends at 50:11.

changed_reading.before: The People of al-Rass are one opaque proper name in an old list.
changed_reading.after: Their dug-site name lets the list rise directly out of the preceding water and earth mechanism: revived ground becomes a model for recoverable, not merely vanished, societies.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final earth-opening and gathering sequence reactivates the Rass branch of digging, insertion, and burial. The named peoples cease to be only remains behind the audience and become a stored population that the earth can open away from and gathering can reassemble.

activation_trace.role: Pit, well, and burial imagery gives one member of the list an explicit below-ground anchor.
The people-image preserves the human collective that can later be reassembled.
Splitting and opening supplies the release of what the ground contains.
The lower realm opposite the sky is the containing material that opens from around them.
Driving and collecting a group toward one destination restores the list's scattered communities as an assembly.

structural_cues: 50:44 says the earth splits from around them and immediately calls the event a gathering.
50:12 preserves prior deniers as named collectives rather than as anonymous ruins.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies burial-capable Rass imagery, earth opening, and group collection; I project the final universal mechanism back onto the named peoples. The live alternative is that the final gathering has no special backward tie to al-Rass beyond the surah's general resurrection frame.

changed_reading.before: The listed communities are extinguished examples confined to the past.
changed_reading.after: The list also reads as an inventory of populations held in the earth: al-Rass's burial image anticipates their opening-out and re-gathering.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus ayah predicates denial of whole peoples, while the later speech-recording sequence resolves collective posture into emitted words under guard and witnessed presence. `قَوْمُ` becomes the social amplifier of denial, not an undifferentiated unit of liability.

activation_trace.role: The people or social-following branch supplies the collective heading under which denial is remembered.
Assigning falsehood identifies the speech-position whose production can be traced person by person.
Emitting speech by the tongue decomposes a communal stance into discrete verbal acts.
Spoken utterance supplies the accountable unit through which denial is enacted.
Guarding and preservation prevent each utterance from dissolving into anonymous group speech.
Presence with direct witnessing carries the individually preserved act into judgment.

structural_cues: 50:16-18 moves from hidden self-talk to every emitted saying and a present watcher.
50:21 changes scale from named peoples to `كُلُّ نَفْسٍ` accompanied by a witness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a collective subject, then individually emitted and guarded speech, then witnessed selves; I apply that accountability resolution retrospectively to the historical catalogue. A live alternative is that the later record scene addresses only the current audience and does not specify how collective naming works.

changed_reading.before: A people denies as one corporate actor.
changed_reading.after: The corporate label records a socially amplified pattern, but the pattern is built from guarded utterances that remain attributable to witnessed persons.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later replay of the before-them formula expands temporal precedent into a stress test: earlier generations had greater force, traversed and probed the lands, yet found no deviation-route. The focus catalogue therefore maps not just what happened earlier but a path whose escape options have already been exhausted.

activation_trace.role: Temporal precedence supplies the line of earlier cases later expanded into tested precedent.
Capacity to face and repel turns the precedent into a test of whether greater power could withstand the outcome.
Falling into ruin states the terminal result of earlier generations.
Greater force and solidity remove weakness as an explanation for their failure.
Seizing with coercive strength makes their superior practical power explicit.
Traveling and probing through lands supplies an active search for an outlet.
Turning aside from a direction names the unavailable escape route.

structural_cues: 50:36 repeats `قَبْلَهُم` and elaborates earlier generations through superior force, movement through lands, and a closing escape question.
50:12's short catalogue is thereby revisited near the surah's end rather than left as a local historical aside.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated temporal formula and a sequence from greater force through geographic search to no escape; I treat 50:36 as an expansion of the function of 50:12. A live alternative is that it is a fresh generic corroboration rather than a direct elaboration of the named list.

changed_reading.before: Earlier deniers merely demonstrate chronological repetition.
changed_reading.after: They are field-tested precedents: stronger collective force and exhaustive movement had already failed to create an exit, so the past cases stand on the addressees' road ahead.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah closes the distance between recitation and event: a hearer is commanded to listen, the cry is heard with reality, and the final instruction uses recitation as reminder of the warning. The historical denials become repeated failures of receptive hearing inside a whole-surah acoustic circuit.

activation_trace.role: The falsehood attribution is recast as a response to received speech rather than an isolated opinion.
Auditory reception supplies the unavoidable hearing at the far end of the circuit.
The alarming cry turns warning from deniable report into directly received event.
A reminder that makes something present again defines the intended function of the closing address.
Recitation and reading supply the voiced medium through which the warning reaches a hearer.
Threatening warning is the content first heard as recitation and later heard as the cry.

structural_cues: The Quran is named at both 50:1 and 50:45, making recitation a surah-wide frame.
50:41 commands listening, 50:42 states actual hearing, and 50:45 returns to reminder by recitation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recitation, reminder, warning, commanded listening, and eventual hearing; I arrange them as an escalation in reception and place 50:12's denial within it. A live alternative is that these are distinct address and resurrection scenes rather than one acoustic mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The old communities rejected a proposition in the past.
changed_reading.after: Their denial is a failed listening response repeated across generations, suspended between warning as recited speech and warning as an event that will be heard directly.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because `خَلْق` in 50:15 visibly denotes first and new creation, not fabricated speech. It remains valid as a lexical countercurrent because the packet gives `خ ل ق` a branch for inventing a lie and the focus verb a branch for assigning falsehood. Downstream prose should present it only as a reversible authorship-charge activated by the branch inventory, never as the local syntax of `خَلْق`.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: `كَذَّبَتْ` as assigning a thing or its bearer to falsehood.

activation_trace.role: Assigning falsehood supplies one side of a dispute over which account is fabricated.
The root's branch of inventing lies or speech reflects a fabrication charge through the verse's first and new creation vocabulary.

changed_reading.before: The communities simply label the message false.
changed_reading.after: At the exploratory branch level, denial becomes a contest over authorship: those disputing first and new creation assign fabrication outward while constructing a counter-account that the creation-root can itself image as invented speech.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because `الرَّسِّ` is syntactically a proper group label and its inward-rehearsal branch is remote from a place-name reading. It remains anchored in the packet's exact Rass branch and is activated by the later hidden-self-talk to uttered-speech sequence. Downstream prose should retain al-Rass as the referent and qualify this only as a semantic echo of rehearsed communal self-talk.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The compound `أَصْحَابُ ٱلرَّسِّ` under the denial predicate.

activation_trace.role: Companionship and continual association provide the social carrier for repeated inward talk.
Turning speech repeatedly in the self supplies the outlier's inward-rehearsal image.
The lying self connects communal denial to an internally maintained narrative without replacing the verb's ordinary sense.
Hidden self-talk supplies the context's explicit inward speech stage.
What resides in the self as thought or apprehension locates that hidden rehearsal.
Speech still held in the self bridges the Rass rehearsal image to the later threshold of utterance.

changed_reading.before: The People of al-Rass are only a geographically labeled denying group.
changed_reading.after: As a contained semantic echo, they can also image a community companioned to speech it repeatedly turns within itself, so public denial emerges from socially shared inward rehearsal.

strongest_changes: 50:14 supplies the denied messengers and makes the warning's becoming due the closure of the 50:12 catalogue.
The focus cluster of standing, companionship, and fixation is reversed by 50:5: socially stabilized denial produces or accompanies epistemic disorder.
The Rass well or burial branch links the immediately preceding water-and-emergence mechanism to the final earth-opening and gathering mechanism.
Later guarded utterance and witness imagery resolves a collectively named denial into individually attributable speech acts.
The 50:36 replay turns `before them` from chronology into an exhausted precedent of superior force, geographic search, and no escape.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package made the short historical list function simultaneously as message precedent, unstable social system, subsurface regeneration hinge, accountability heading, and failed escape map. Al-Rass was the unusually productive anchor because its packet branches join fixity, wells or burial, and inward rehearsal without forcing those readings into one synthesis.
remaining_uncertainties: How strongly a proper name such as al-Rass should retain its packet branch imagery in ordinary rendering.
Whether denial causes the `مَرِيج` state in 50:5 or that disorder helps cause denial.
How specifically the universal earth-opening and individual-record scenes should be projected back onto the named historical groups.
The creation-as-fabrication reversal and inward-rehearsal Rass reading remain deliberately branch-distant overlays.
